Stylish 1-Bedroom Apartment in Myrtle, Central Park at City Walk – Dubai

Discover contemporary urban living in this beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment located in Myrtle, Central Park at City Walk. Spanning 720.32 sq ft, this thoughtfully laid-out home offers a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in one of Dubai’s most vibrant communities.

The apartment features a bright and spacious living area with large windows that invite natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The modern open-plan kitchen is fitted with high-quality finishes, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The well-appointed bedroom offers ample storage and a serene retreat, complemented by a sleek, contemporary bathroom.

Set within the lush, green surroundings of Central Park at City Walk, residents enjoy access to world-class amenities including landscaped parks, walking trails, fitness facilities, and swimming pools. The community is perfectly positioned with easy access to premium retail, dining, and entertainment options, making it a sought-after destination for modern city living.

Property Highlights:

1 Bedroom | 1 Bathroom
720.32 sq ft
Open-plan kitchen and living area
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Premium finishes throughout
Access to exclusive amenities

Ideal for professionals, couples, or investors seeking a prime property in the heart of Dubai.
